Row 4 lists a 529 Account with Edvest Edvest does not report interest or dividends. Based on a telephone inquiry, Edvest reported interest/divident income of

Rows 31-36 relate to a Northwestern Mutual Financial Network Variable Life Insurance Policy. The company reports a small total for dividends for the policy of

I during the reporting period. The company does not break this number out by underling funds invested in through the policy. After multiple calls and

and (2) on the Financial Disclosure form, 1 have allocated the total dividend pro rata across the underlying investments within the policy.
